shortBulletSummary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw record $3.79B outflows in November, deepening crypto market selloff.
A major whale liquidated 11,000 BTC ($1.3B), adding to recent selling pressure.
Elections today could impact crypto regulation and market volatility.
A late October Binance security incident continues to weigh on overall crypto sentiment.
The Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy and inflation risks limit demand for risky assets.
